column4: Close-up on a green background. Only the doll's right forearm and open hand, seen from the side at the center of the frame, lightly resting its fingertips against one single thin vertical string of tan gold (#A68957) that runs from the top edge to the bottom edge of the frame. Ruffled white cuff, wrist ring and ball joint visible, black sleeve running off the left edge. Five clear fingers. The entire background is flat pure chroma green (#00B140) except the string itself; no text.

Continue the first reference: identical camera, forearm and string, but the hand has now closed around the string and pulled it sharply downward and to the side: the fist is clenched on the string, which is bent into a taut V shape at the knuckles, the wrist dropped a little lower. Same flat chroma green background, five clear fingers, no text.

Same camera and scale as the reference. She stands very still at the edge, head bowed and tilted down as if looking at something below her feet, both hands pinching and lifting the hem of her skirt a little off her boots, toes together at the very front. Three-quarter front view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.
